acceptanceCriteria: A declared-isolation profile takes server identity (URL + revision/digest) and a pinned reset/health hook, verifies identity before and after each control, resets between controls, and reports infrastructure_failed (never killed) on drift or reset failure; the receipt records the declared isolation.

A runner-neutral control profile takes a pinned perturbation hook under the same plan-approval and containment rules, reruns selected examples through a non-browser provider, and reports the six closed statuses.
At least the Go provider is wired end to end; Ruby wiring follows #1271 or is a recorded residual.
Spec requirements, fail-without-fix tests and a build-log entry are recorded.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1273: BBF-V0-004 only runs controls in a disposable workspace, so adopters testing against a long-lived local app server get no assertion strength. #1274: negative controls are browser-only; Ruby/Go provider examples stay NOT_MEASURED. Owning spec browser-behavior-falsification-v0 (BBF-V0). #1274's Ruby binding depends on #1271 example selection.
title: Falsification: declared-isolation shared-server profile and runner-neutral negative controls for non-browser providers (GitHub #1273, #1274)
